captures.title: Olimex PCB layout
captures.interaction: Open the retained Olimex project and choose Layout. The saved PCB is the drawing source.
captures.limits: Saved source shown.

captures.title: Real component models in 3D
captures.interaction: Switch the same board to 3D. The capture reports 126 of 143 components linked to repository models.
captures.limits: Model coverage is partial; unlinked components are not evidence of a complete mechanical assembly.

captures.title: Project-wide search
captures.interaction: Search the loaded real project and inspect the matching saved objects and paths.
captures.limits: Search evidence is limited to the loaded project.

captures.title: 3D selection and native properties
captures.interaction: Select a real component in 3D and inspect its saved field/value properties.
captures.limits: Selection and properties are viewing operations, not design edits.

captures.title: Selected +5V copper
captures.interaction: Select the saved +5V net. The inspected selection contains 64 track segments and four vias.
captures.limits: Saved-net inspection is not electrical or manufacturing qualification.

captures.title: Layout probe over the 3D board
captures.interaction: Open a layout probe while keeping the main board in 3D.
captures.limits: The popup is an independent viewport in the same application page.

captures.title: Independent sibling probes
captures.interaction: Rotate the layout probe by 90 degrees, open a sibling 3D probe, and drag the second popup to the right. Curved source guides remain visible.
captures.limits: The second popup moved from DOM x=76 to x=532; this is not a separate installed application window.

captures.title: Paired 3D and schematic views
captures.interaction: Open the actual project schematic beside the board 3D view.
captures.limits: Pairing uses the retained saved project; it does not synchronize unsaved KiCad editor state.

captures.title: Saved pad selection
captures.interaction: Select a pad and inspect its saved properties.
captures.limits: This capture proves pad selection only. The search/navigation step returns to a single PCB view; it is not evidence of paired pin highlighting.

captures.title: Actual +5V cross-selection
captures.interaction: Cross-select +5V between the PCB and schematic; inspect the saved pin/pad-name properties.
captures.limits: This observed saved-net match does not establish every possible cross-sheet or repeated-unit mapping.

captures.title: Layers and terminal labels
captures.interaction: Use the floating layer controls and the independent number/net-name controls.
captures.limits: Shown label visibility depends on zoom, saved identities and annotation budgets.

captures.title: BoM column chooser
captures.interaction: Open the BoM table and choose the fields to display.
captures.limits: Fields come from the saved project; column choices do not rewrite the design.

captures.title: Local assembly tracking
captures.interaction: Mark one assembly entry Placed. The local demonstration shows one placed and 142 not started.
captures.limits: These are demonstration tracking states, not a record of physical assembly.

captures.title: Board-extent measurement
captures.interaction: Measure the saved board outline in the viewer.
captures.limits: Screen measurements are review aids, without inferred manufacturing tolerances.

captures.title: Local review-note composer
captures.interaction: Create a local Minor-severity issue draft with its drawing location.
captures.limits: No provider comment is sent.

captures.title: Locate a saved local note
captures.interaction: Save the local draft and choose Locate to return to its drawing location.
captures.limits: This demonstrates local save/locate only, not remote publication or readback.

captures.title: Filter local review notes
captures.interaction: Filter the saved local review entries.
captures.limits: Account threads and remote conversation refresh are not exercised.

captures.title: Reviewed Fast PI setup
captures.interaction: Review a 5 V, 0.1 A, 58 MS/m setup using the saved stackup.
captures.limits: Setup only: this actual Olimex board is rejected for unsupported slotted drills. No solved PI result is shown.

captures.title: KiCad-style Draftsman sheet
captures.interaction: Choose the KiCad-style template and dimension the 28 × 80 mm board outline.
captures.limits: The drawing document is separate from the PCB source.

captures.title: Multiple documentation views
captures.interaction: Arrange top and isometric views with copper hidden.
captures.limits: View visibility is a documentation choice, not a change to saved copper.

captures.title: Generated PDF ready
captures.interaction: Generate the PDF and save a local drawing draft; the download link remains available.
captures.limits: GitHub save is disabled without authentication. This does not demonstrate a remote repository save.

captures.title: Project home and saved files
captures.interaction: Return to project home and inspect the actual saved source files.
captures.limits: The capture uses a loopback local-project bridge, not live provider discovery.

captures.title: Upstream Gerber layers
captures.interaction: Open the 13 actual upstream fabrication files from the pinned repository revision. Twelve render in this capture.
captures.limits: Partial import: PTH is rejected for unsupported slots/macros. The files are upstream saved outputs, not newly plotted from the current board.

captures.title: Partial Gerber analysis
captures.interaction: Inspect the saved fabrication analysis and its 1,002 findings.
captures.limits: Findings are screening data, not DFM certification. Unsupported PTH slots/macros and incomplete rendering remain explicit.

captures.title: Marble root and hierarchy
captures.interaction: Open the actual Marble root schematic and its saved hierarchy.
captures.limits: This capture corpus deliberately excludes the 44 MB PCB and all models.

captures.title: All loaded schematic pages
captures.interaction: Open the all-sheets overview of all 25 loaded pages. Repeated QSFP2 is represented by a two-instance stack.
captures.limits: The overview does not claim that every repeated instance has been expanded into a separate page.

captures.title: Only sheets matching FPGA_MISO
captures.interaction: Highlight FPGA_MISO and show only its four matching sheets.
captures.limits: The filter reflects this saved net and loaded sources, not a general connectivity proof.

captures.title: Net links without hierarchy links
captures.interaction: Turn hierarchy links off while leaving net links on.
captures.limits: The two link overlays are controlled independently.

captures.title: Sheet-level net indicators
captures.interaction: Use sheet indicators to follow the highlighted saved net.
captures.limits: Indicators reflect the active saved selection.

captures.title: Schematic theme control
captures.interaction: Toggle the schematic theme while retaining the loaded drawing.
captures.limits: Theme changes presentation, not source geometry.

captures.title: FMCW3 legacy root
captures.interaction: Open the authentic FMCW3 legacy root schematic.
captures.limits: Restricted legacy preview; unsupported records or missing library content may be omitted with diagnostics.

captures.title: FMCW3 power subsheet
captures.interaction: Navigate from the root to the saved power subsheet.
captures.limits: Schematic navigation works here. The FMCW3 PCB fails with “Invalid numeric KiCad value”; no successful PCB capture is included.

captures.title: About the packaged version
captures.interaction: Open About and read the packaged 0.12.79 version.
captures.limits: The UI is from the audited package, served locally; this does not prove a store installation.

captures.workflow: Generated downloads and responsive web previews
captures.title: Generated layout PDF
captures.interaction: Choose Generate and download PDF. Production status reports “Generated ESP32-PoE_Rev_M2.pdf · 1920 × 4096 pixels. Your browser handles download”.
captures.limits: The PDF was generated and download was handed to the browser. No downloaded filesystem path was verified.

captures.workflow: Generated downloads and responsive web previews
captures.title: Narrow layout web preview
captures.interaction: Inspect the real Olimex layout in a narrow responsive web viewport.
captures.limits: Requested viewport 390 × 844 at 75% browser zoom; actual DOM and JPEG are 520 × 1125, device-pixel ratio 0.75. This is not a physical Android capture.

captures.workflow: Generated downloads and responsive web previews
captures.title: Narrow local-comment web preview
captures.interaction: Open the local comment interface in the narrow responsive web viewport.
captures.limits: Requested viewport 390 × 844 at 75% browser zoom; actual DOM and JPEG are 520 × 1125, device-pixel ratio 0.75. Notes remain local; no provider send is demonstrated.

captures.workflow: Generated downloads and responsive web previews
captures.title: Narrow 3D web preview
captures.interaction: Switch the real board to 3D and wait for the visible 126/143 linked-model status.
captures.limits: Requested viewport 390 × 844 at 75% browser zoom; actual DOM and JPEG are 520 × 1125, device-pixel ratio 0.75. Responsive web evidence only; model coverage remains partial.

captures.workflow: Generated downloads and responsive web previews
captures.title: Tablet-sized 3D web preview
captures.interaction: Inspect the top-camera 3D view after the visible 126/143 linked-model status.
captures.limits: Requested viewport 1024 × 768; JPEG dimensions are recorded below and in the manifest. This is a responsive web preview, not physical tablet or Android validation.
